cleaner.label: Scoop, Chocolatey and WinGet cache
cleaner.description: Downloaded installers and logs of the Scoop, Chocolatey and WinGet package managers. Does not touch installed apps or their data.

option.label: Scoop cache
option.description: Removes the installers and archives downloaded by Scoop (cache folder).
option.warning: Installers are re-downloaded on the next `scoop install` or `scoop update`: network required.

option.label: Files downloaded by Chocolatey
option.description: Removes the packages and installers downloaded by Chocolatey in the temporary folder.
option.warning: Packages are re-downloaded on the next `choco install` or `choco upgrade`: network required.

option.label: Installers downloaded by WinGet
option.description: Removes the installers WinGet downloads to the temporary folder.
option.warning: Installers are re-downloaded on the next `winget install` or `winget upgrade`: network required.
